name: issue-driven-dev
description: v3.3.0: before diagnosing or implementing, idd-all / idd-diagnose / idd-implement ask whether an open PR or an existing branch already addresses the issue (`scripts/check-existing-work.sh`, one call for every issue; verdict blocked / resume / unknown / clear) (#366). v3.2.0: idd-discuss captures explicitly selected human/AI conversations as append-only GitHub Discussion snapshots (#331). Stable topic/source IDs, payload fingerprints, shared egress checks, local locks and uncertain-write reconciliation protect retry behavior without promising distributed exactly-once or AI correctness. idd-ask adds bounded Discussion/comment/reply evidence alongside existing issue retrieval, with corpus selection and explicit partial-read reporting. Security repair #332 replaces delimiter and URL-prefix exemptions with maintained parsers and source-faithful checks. Runtime prerequisite: install scripts/requirements-egress.txt; missing/incompatible parser versions refuse egress. v3.1.1: `idd-issue --blocked-by` calls GitHub's real `addBlockedBy` mutation and prints GitHub's error verbatim (#353). v3.1.0: the actionability gate, rounds 2 to 7. Round 1 read `### Complexity` against a closed value domain that the repository's own 159 diagnoses refuted (66 real values wrongly refused) and shipped a three-signal gate no consumer called. Now the tier is the leading whole word (rationale, decoration and ` via` suffixes are legal), the whole line is scanned for a small deferral vocabulary (exit 5, reason `complexity-deferral-marker` — a parked state, not a defect), and `### Blocking` is read per bullet by a shared helper with a leading-token placeholder rule frozen against the repo's 55 real rows — 54 sections under CommonMark (54/55 agree with hand review; round 2 had withheld 30 of the 48 empty ones, #316 itself among them). idd-list / idd-all / idd-implement / idd-plan call the verdict with all three signals before any branch or comment, print it as a machine line plus a delimited raw block, and repeat the gate byte for byte where a later step routes on it (pinned by test). Fences follow CommonMark's two visibility rules; the reader's known divergences from CommonMark are listed with their direction and pinned, not claimed exhaustive. The placeholder rule does not depend on the locale or on a shell function named grep; the matchers that still follow the environment are listed with their measured directions (#336). Changes to the reader are gated: vocabulary rules move only toward withholding unless a named corpus row requires the change; structural rules (headings, fences, bullets, trimming, and the locale of their matchers) are frozen until a requirement names the oracle they converge on (#336). idd-list gains Parked and Needs-diagnosis groups; the #84 blocked surface is preserved verbatim.
